Bũmb ning sẽn be saasẽ la sẽn be Tẽngẽ yɩlgda Wẽnde, Yẽ la zɩslem Naaba n yaa Bʋʋd-Mita.
Saas la Tẽng naam yaa Yẽ n so, A vɩɩmsdame la A kʋʋda, Yẽ n leb n yaa Tõod ne bũmbã fãa gilli.
Yẽ la Rẽenem la Yaoolem la sẽn Vẽneg la sẽn be Pʋgẽ, Yẽnda me yaa bũmbã fãa Mita.

Yẽ la Naab ning sẽn naan saas la Tẽng rasem a yoob pʋgẽ, rẽ poorẽ t'A zẽk Al-ʿarsã (Naamã goeel) yingri (zẽkr sẽn tog ne Wẽnde). A mii bũmb ning sẽn kẽed Tẽngã pʋgẽ la bũmb ning sẽn yit a pʋgẽ, la bũmb ning sẽn sigd saagẽ wã la bũmb ning sẽn rʋʋd beenẽ. la A lagma yãmba, yãmb sẽn beẽ fãa. Wẽnd leb n yaa Mit ne bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
Saas la Tẽng naam yaa Yẽ n so, la Wẽnd nengẽ la b lebsd yεlã.
A kẽesda yʋng wĩndg pʋgẽ, la A kẽesd wĩndg yʋng pʋgẽ, la Yẽnda me yaa Mit ne bũmb ning sẽn be yãadẽ.
Kõ-y sɩd ne Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã, la y yãk n naf bũmb ning pʋga A sẽn maan yãmb tɩ y ledsd taab a pʋgẽ wã. Neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd yãmb pʋgẽ la b yãk n nafã, bãmb tara keoor sẽn bedme.
Yaa bõe n tar yãmb tɩ y pa kõt sɩd ne Wẽnde tɩ Tẽn-tʋʋmã yaool n boond yãmb tɩ y kõ sɩd ne y Soabã, la a yaoool n reega yãmb alkaoole, tɩ yãmb sã n yɩ n yaa sɩd-kõatba?
Yẽ la Soab ning sẽn sik yãmb zug Aayay-vẽenesã, t'a na yiis yãmb ligsẽ wã n tʋg vẽenmẽ wã, la Wẽnd yaa ninbãan-zoεt n yaa yoalsd ne yãmba.

La yaa bõe n tar yãmb tɩ y pa na n yãk n naf Wẽnd sorã zugu, tɩ saas la Tẽng faad yaool n yaa Wẽnd n so? Pa makd yãmb pʋgẽ, ned ning sẽn yãk n naf taoor tɩ (Mak) pakrã pa ta ye, la a zabe, bãmbã n yɩɩd zɩslem ne dargε n yɩɩd neb nins sẽn yãk n naf pakrã poorẽ la b zabe, la fãa gilli, Wẽnd pʋlma ne sẽn sõmbe, Wẽnd yaa kiba-Mit ne bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
Ãnd n na n peng Wẽnde, pengr sẽn be neere, t'A fão-a n kõ-a, la a leb n tar keoor sẽn bedme.

Raar ning fo sẽn yãt Muumin raopã la muumin pogsã tɩ b nuura wã yaa sẽn yãgd b nems taoore la b rɩtg wεεngẽ: "yãmb sũ-noogr rũnda yaa arzãn-rãmb ko-sood sẽn zoet a tẽngre, yãmb yaa sẽn duumd a pʋgẽ, woto la pʋɩ-bedre".

Raar ning munaafɩg-roap la munaafig-pogs sẽn yet neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã: "yals-y n koll-y tõnd tɩ d mok yãmb nuura wã". Tɩ b yeele: "leb-y poorẽ wã n tɩ bao nuura". Tɩ b ning lalg bãmb sʋka, a tara ragnoore, a pʋgẽ wã yolsg n be beenẽ, la a yɩngã wεεngẽ yaa naong n be beenẽ.

B boond-b lame: "tõnd ra pa yɩ n be ne yãmba?" Tɩ b yeele: " n-yẽe! La ad yãmb zarba y mens la y rag n kor wẽnga la y maan sika, tɩ saagr belg yãmb hal tɩ Wẽnd yεlã wa, tɩ belg-m-meng soabã (Sʋɩtãana) belg yãmba n yi Wẽnde".
La rũndã b pa reegd yõor yaood yãmb (munaafigsã) nengẽ ye, pa neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã me nengẽ ye, yãmb gãag zĩig yaa Bugmẽ, yẽ la yãmb lallda, la baasg yɩ wẽnga".

Wakat pa ta ne sẽn kõ-b sɩd ne Wẽndã tɩ b sũyã yaees ne Wẽnd yʋʋr tẽegre, la bũmb ning sẽn sig n yaa sɩdã, la b ra yɩ wala b sẽn kõ-b rãmb gafã hal pĩndã, tɩ wakat wogl ne-bɑ, tɩ b sũyã kʋɩ, la wʋsg sẽn yi bãmb pʋgẽ fãa yaa Dĩin yitba.
Bãng-y tɩ yaa Wẽnd n vɩɩmsd Tẽngã a kũumã poorẽ, sɩd la hakɩɩka Tõnd vẽnega Aayayã ne yãmba sãnd-sãnde y na tall yam.
Bãng-y tɩ sãrã maandb-roapã, la sãrã maandb-pogsã la nins sẽn peng Wẽnd pengr sẽn be neerã, b fãoodame n kõ bãmba, bãmb leb n tara keoor sẽn bedme.

La neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnd la Tẽn-tʋʋmã, bãmb la sɩd-kõtb mense, la sẽn ki-b Wẽnd sorã yĩnga b Soabã nengẽ b tara b keoor la b nuura, la neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã la b yags Tõnd Aayayã bãmb la Gεhɩɩm koambã.

Bãng-y tɩ ad Dũni vɩɩmã yaa wɩsg la reem la faas teedo, la pug taaba, la wʋsgr baoob arzεgsẽ la koambẽ. Yaa wala sa-koom bilgri, a bõn-bundi wã sẽn maan ka-koaadb yel-solemde, rẽ poorẽ t'a zelg tɩ fo ne-a t'a yaa kõodre, rẽ poorẽ t'a zendge, la yaoolem raarã naong sẽn keeme n be beenẽ, la yaafa sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ la yardo. Lɑ dũni vɩɩmã pa yɩ rẽnda belg-m-meng wʋm-noogo.

Reng-y taab n tʋg yaafa sẽn yi yãmb Soabã nengẽ la arzãn a yalem sẽn yaa wala saagã la Tẽngã yalem tɩ b segl n bĩng neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽndã la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã. Woto yaa Wẽnd yɩɩdlem t'A kõt A sẽn rat a soaba, la Wẽnd yaa yɩɩd bedr Soaba.
Yell pa yɩ sẽn na paam Tẽngã pʋga, pa yãmb pʋgẽ me, rẽndame tɩ bee gaf pʋgẽ taoor tɩ Tõnd na n pa yɩɩs-a ye, ad rẽnda ne Wẽnd yaa yol-yole.
Bʋɩl yĩng tɩ yãmb ra wa sãam y sũur ne bũmb ning sẽn põsg yãmbã ye, la y ra wa n kɩdem me ne bũmb ning A sẽn kõ yãmbã ye, la Wẽnd pa nong Waoog-m-meng soab fãa sẽn yaa pugd ye.
Neb nins sẽn maand beed la b sagend nebã ne beedã, la ned ning sẽn gũt a a kuidga, ad Wẽnde, Yẽnda la sek-m-meng Soaba n yaa pẽgr Naaba.

Sɩd la hakɩɩka Tõnd tʋmsa d Tẽn-tʋʋmbã ne vẽenese, la Tõnd sik gafã n kõ-ba, la tẽeg tɩrga; bʋɩl yĩng tɩ nebã na yals ne tẽeg tɩrga. Tõnd sika kutã tɩ keelem be a pʋgẽ la nafa ne nebã; la Wẽnd na wilg tɩ b bãng ned ning sẽn sõngda Yẽ la A Tẽn-tʋʋmbã ne solgre, ad Wẽnd yaa pãng Soab n yaa wilb Naaba.
La sɩd la hakɩɩka Tõnd tʋmsa a Nuuh la a ɭbraahɩɩm, la Tõnd ninga b yiibã koamb pʋgẽ Nabiyaam-rãmb la Gafo, tɩ kãndgdb be bãmb pʋgẽ, la wʋsg sẽn yi bãmb pʋgẽ fãa yaa dĩin yitba.

Rẽ poorẽ tɩ Tõnd pʋgl bãmb vũunã zugu, ne Tõnd Tẽn-tʋʋmbã, la Tõnd pʋgl a Maryam biig a ʿIisa, la D kõ-a Ingiili, la D ning neb nins sẽn pʋg-a wã sũyẽ nimbãan-zoεεg la yolsgo. La tũudum ning bãmb sẽn sɩnga, Tõnd pa gʋls-a n rogl-b ye, sã n pa Wẽnd yard baoob yĩnga, la b pa gũus-a gũusg sɩd-sɩd ye, tɩ Tõnd rol sẽn kõ-b sɩdã b pʋgẽ wã b keoore. La wʋsg sẽn yi b pʋgẽ fãa yaa dĩin yitba.

Yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! Zoe-y Wẽnd la y kõ sɩd ne A Tẽn-tʋʋmã t'A na kõ yãmb pʋɩɩr a yiib sẽn yi A yolsgẽ wã, la A ning yãmb nuura tɩ y kẽnd ne-a, la A yaaf yãmba, la Wẽnd yaa yaafg Naaba n yaa yoalsda.
Bʋɩl yĩng tɩ Gafã rãmb bãng tɩ b pa tõe baa fʋɩ Wẽnd yɩɩdlemã pʋgẽ ye, la ad yɩɩdlem bee Wẽnd nengẽ t'A kõt A sẽn rat a soaba, la Wẽnd yaa yɩɩd bedr Soaba.
